Account — Investments, at cost

This form allows to rename built-in Investments, at cost account.

To access this form, go to Settings, then Chart of Accounts, then click Edit button for Investments, at cost account.

The form contains the following fields:

Name

Name of account. The default name is Investments, at cost but it can be renamed.

Code

Enter code of the account if desired

Group

Select group on Balance Sheet under which this account should be presented.

CashFlowStatementInvestingActivityGroup

Select group on Cash Flow Statement under which this account should be presented.

Click Update button to save your changes.

This account cannot be deleted, it is automatically added to your Chart of Accounts when you have created at least one invenstment.

For more information see: Investments
